name: TrustDemoIND04
title: TD.IND.04 Imported doses carrying a national schedule code
description: Of the foreign doses imported as verified, the proportion that carry a national schedule code beside the issuer's code, and so count toward the schedule.
guidance: A definition only: it states no target and no value. Data elements: DVCMinPreQual.vx.vp Vaccine product id; IMMZImmunization.primarySource Primary source; IMMZImmunization.vaccineCode Vaccine code. Decision tables: TD.DT.02, TD.DT.03. Requirements: STD-SEM-001, STD-SCH-001. The populations are described, not computable: this guide carries no CQL.

population.description: Doses imported as verified in the reporting period.

criteria.expression: COUNT of Immunization (IMMZImmunization) WHERE primarySource = true AND imported in the reporting period

population.description: Doses imported as verified in the reporting period that carry a national schedule code.

criteria.expression: COUNT of Immunization (IMMZImmunization) WHERE primarySource = true AND imported in the reporting period AND vaccineCode has a coding from TrustDemoOnesaEpiScheduleCodes
